courses.name: B.Tech Computer Engineering
courses.full_name: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Engineering
courses.description: Undergraduate engineering program in Computer Engineering.
courses.eligibility: For Maharashtra State candidates, the candidate must have passed HSC with Physics and Mathematics and any one of Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Technical or Vocational subjects, with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories), and must have a valid MHT-CET or non-zero positive JEE Main score. A Diploma in Engineering with 45% marks (40% for reserved categories) is also an acceptable route.
